recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-34147 unless a future work group decision reopens canonical resource name syntax or explicitly brings historical release archive artifacts into scope.
issue_request: FHIR-34147 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core change request, raised for R5 CodeSystem, asking that the machine-friendly name regular expression require at least one character after the initial uppercase letter by using `[A-Z]([A-Za-z0-9_]){1,254}` instead of `[A-Z]([A-Za-z0-9_]){0,254}`.
initial_application: Commit 70ad673b9e1f81ff3c228e62b42f005a1538d9ad explicitly applied FHIR-34147 by changing the cnl-0 name regular expressions in CanonicalResource, CodeSystem, and Questionnaire from `{0,254}` to `{1,254}`.
additional_context: CodeSystem is active in `source/fhir.ini`, and the current CodeSystem source uses `name.exists() implies name.matches('^[A-Z]([A-Za-z0-9_]){1,254}$')`. Searches found no remaining `{0,254}` occurrences in current `source/`; remaining stale-looking hits are historical R4 release archive content under `tools/history/release4`. Related audits FHIR-36127 and FHIR-36184, already represented on the combined branch, explain the intentional `name.exists() implies` guard around the same regex family.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already implements the approved minimum-length regex for the seed artifact and the broader canonical-name regex family.

related_jiras.note: Audited the optional-name `name.exists() implies` guard around the same canonical name regex family and explains why the current expression is guarded.
Audited the Questionnaire-specific optional-name guard and cites FHIR-34147 as the later approved reason for the current `{1,254}` quantifier.
